teaching_structure.teaching_activities:
Ask students to name substances added to food during preparation or storage.
Explain the term food additives and their general purpose.

Respond to teacher questions.
Share examples of substances they ve seen added to food (e.g., salt, vinegar, colouring).

teaching_structure.teaching_activities:

Discuss how additives improve flavour, appearance, or preservation.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Ask students:  What happens when someone does not eat enough food or eats too much of one type of food?
